dataset_role: Previously exposed assistant-authored reference-v1 regression corpus; no new independent quality-selection claim.

live_profiles.quality_role: Regression diagnostics only; six delivered excerpts do not establish nDCG@10 or answerability. Preserve all individual losses.

memory_scope: Exact-child worker peak RSS; separately sampled task-owned Ollama server/runner RSS and API model size/size_vram. Do not sum RSS as unique physical memory. GPU/shared physical allocations may remain unavailable.
recommendation_gate: No new production profile recommendation without at least 50 genuine independently reviewed pilot cases and a separately frozen family-split quality/resource evaluation.
